'''Marden''' was an individual who worked for the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Reegas Vance]]. Marden served aboard Vance's [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] [[Junker (YT-2400 light freighter)|''Blackstar'']] and accompanied the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] when it traveled to salvage a derelict ship in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Rival salvagers [[Khedryn Faal]] and [[Marr Idi-Shael]] also planned to salvage the derelict and after Vance boarded the pair's [[Seeker (starship)|starship]] and found it to be empty, he suspected that Faal and Idi-Shael had abandoned their vessel so that they could steal the derelict. To prevent them from seizing the derelict, Vance ordered Marden to disable the derelict's engines. Marden then fired upon the derelict with the ''Blackstar''s [[Plasma cannon/Legends|cannons]].

==Behind the scenes==
Marden was created by the writer [[Paul S. Kemp]] and appeared in the short story ''[[A Fair Trade]]'', which was published in the [[Star Wars Insider 129|129th edition]] of the magazine ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' in [[2011]].
